title: Hotel Transylvania
description: Hotel Transylvania is the perfect place for monsters to escape the human world, until an unwitting hitchhiker tries to check in. Animated fun with the voice of Adam Sandler.

title: Hotel Transylvania 2
description: Dracula recruits his friends to help bring out the monster in his half human, half vampire grandson. Animated sequel with the voices of Adam Sandler and Andy Samberg.

title: Hotel Transylvania 3: A Monster Vacation
description: A stressed-out Dracula is whisked away on a luxury summer cruise. Animated fun with the voice of Adam Sandler.

title: Cats & Dogs: The Revenge Of Kitty Galore
description: With a feline superspy plotting world domination, cats and dogs must put their rivalries aside to defeat her. Family fun. Mild violence/flashing images.

title: Cloudy With A Chance Of Meatballs
description: An inventor builds a machine that turns rain showers into food showers, but greed soon sends it spinning out of control. Delectable animation with the voice of Anna Faris.

title: Cloudy With A Chance Of Meatballs 2
description: Chaos ensues when a scientist discovers his invention, which turns water into meals, is creating animals made of food. Flashing images.

title: Despicable Me 3
description: Dismissed from the Anti-Villain League after botching a mission, Gru sets off to meet his long-lost twin brother. Smash-hit animated sequel.

title: Jumanji
description: A man trapped inside a magical boardgame is freed with a zoo-full of rampaging jungle beasts. Wild fantasy adventure with Robin Williams.

title: Jumanji: Welcome To The Jungle
description: Four teens in detention discover an old video game that sucks them into the dangerous world of Jumanji. Dwayne Johnson stars.

title: Jumanji: The Next Level
description: The gang is back as Dwayne Johnson, Kevin Hart and Jack Black return to Jumanji.

title: Journey 2: The Mysterious Island
description: After intercepting a cryptic radio message, intrepid Josh Hutcherson and stepdad Dwayne Johnson set off across the Pacific on a magical voyage of discovery. Flashing images.

title: The Golden Compass
description: In a parallel universe, a young girl called Lyra comes into possession of a magical compass that is the beginning of an epic quest to save her friends and her world.

title: The Borrowers
description: Fun comic adventure about a four-inch high family who fall foul of nasty lawyer John Goodman. Tom Felton - Draco Malfoy in the Harry Potter films - makes his acting debut.

title: The Cinema List: Family Favourites
description: Discover some of the very best Sky Originals to watch with the whole family, from Monster Family to The Amazing Maurice.

title: Karate Kid: Legends
description: Li Fong relocates to New York City and attracts unwanted attention from a local karate champion. He embarks on a journey to enter the ultimate karate competition.

title: The Rugrats Movie
description: Tommy and co try to return his new baby brother to the hospital in this fun animation. With the voices of Whoopi Goldberg and Busta Rhymes. Contains flashing images.

title: Rugrats Go Wild
description: It's cartoon chaos when the little terrors are marooned on an island with the nature-nutty Thornberrys. Messy fun with the voice of Bruce Willis.

title: Alvin And The Chipmunks
description: Three singing chipmunks hit the big time in LA, but will their new-found fame and success make them forget their woodland roots? Family fun with Jason Lee and Justin Long.

title: Alvin And The Chipmunks: The Squeakquel
description: High-pitched fun as the singing rodents take on feisty female furballs The Chipettes in a Battle of the Bands contest. With Anna Faris and Justin Long.

title: Alvin And The Chipmunks: Chipwrecked
description: On a cruise, the Chipmunks go overboard and are washed up on an island. Can Dave come to their rescue? Kid-friendly fun in this third big-screen adventure.

title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Chip
description: Fearing that they might be ditched, Alvin, Simon and Theodore hit the road to prevent long-suffering guardian Dave from proposing. Comedy.

title: The BFG
description: Adaptation of the beloved Roald Dahl tale starring Mark Rylance as the lovable giant who befriends a headstrong young orphan. From Steven Spielberg.

title: Peter Rabbit
description: Beatrix Potter adaptation with James Corden voicing the mischievous rabbit whose feud with the McGregors reaches new heights.
